question: In a certain code language, ‘FLORA’ is written as ‘DORII’. How will ‘MUSIC’ be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ae5efc115000d38a9442de7b29614b0d0cdf1ada7f25abd4e79483f28121110.png] 

‘FLORA’ is written as ‘DORII’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30f9b3a66afa8fadb20c2182200dffa29df4e25b7055559486f1ace5d5a64712.png] 

Similarly,

‘MUSIC’ will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90fd562bd506aa72b4fff7e672a4b7a788941eef1795de071bfc992698d70162.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"FFVRP".**
